description: Swiss AHV/AVS old-age pension (1st pillar, AHV-Rente, rente AVS, rendita AVS). ALWAYS call this for any question about the state pension, including «how much AHV pension will I get?»: never answer a personal amount from memory. Returns the official minimum and maximum (2026, 2027), the 13th pension, reference age, early withdrawal and deferral rates, and a PERSONAL ESTIMATE computed with the law (AHVG Art. 34 formula, partial-pension scale, income splitting for married couples, child-rearing credits, couple cap, AHV 21 supplements). Pass ONLY values the user stated (never guess income, birth year, sex or retirement age). Without average_income it returns questions_to_ask: ask the user those, then call again with the answers. For pillar 3a or pension-fund figures use pension_figures; for tax on a lump-sum withdrawal capital_withdrawal_tax.

age.description: Current age in years, e.g. 55 (use when the user gives an age, not a birth year).

average_income.description: This person’s OWN average gross yearly income in Switzerland over the working life (AHV-liable, today’s CHF), e.g. 85000. A combined household income must be split between the spouses.

birth_year.description: Year of birth, e.g. 1968 (only if the user gave it).

canton.description: 2-letter abbreviation, optional: that canton's pension statistics

children_years.description: Years with a child under 16 (child-rearing credits), e.g. 16.

contribution_years.description: TOTAL AHV contribution years at retirement, including the years still to come (age 21 to retirement; 44 = complete, no gaps). A 55-year-old with no gaps who works to 65 has 44, not 34. Omit if unknown.

married.description: true if married or in a registered partnership.

monthly_pension.description: monthly old-age pension in CHF, optional

months.description: months with an old-age pension in the year, 1 to 12, default 12

retirement_age.description: Planned pension start age, e.g. 64 (early) or 67 (deferred).

sex.description: female or male (reference age, AHV 21 supplement).

spouse_average_income.description: Spouse’s average gross yearly income, today’s CHF, e.g. 40000.

statistics.description: true to add the average pension of every canton.

years_married.description: Contribution years spent married, e.g. 25; omit if not stated.

name: ahv_pension
title: AHV old-age pension
